svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Cut 400 x 400 mm; round the corners to about 5 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes from the centre (the lid hole layout figure gives all of them):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shaft 28 mm in the centre; bearing bolts 11 mm at 32 each way;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: post rods 11 mm at 125 each way; tie rods 11 mm at 170 each way.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Underneath: a ring groove 3 mm deep, 148.8 to 158.5 mm radius, that

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the top of the housing sits in. Rout with a trammel jig.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: On top: a ring groove 2 mm deep, 75.5 to 80.5 mm radius, for the guard.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the two grooves from the same centre as the shaft hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: housing in the lower groove; lower bearing unit, posts and guard

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on top; four tie rods through the corners with washers and nuts.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
